answer: Each challenge is derived from a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse, so its unpredictable, publicly verifiable randomness binds the task to a specific moment and blocks advance computation. A commit-reveal proves timely participation without letting a swarm precompute a hollow stockpile of answers or reuse work across identities. Sybil resistance comes from fresh, auditable effort per challenge—not a velvet promise of identity uniqueness—while the beacon carries each voyage beyond any operator’s ability to choose its outcome.
